# spaceman kb

A space's knowledge bases: list, show, create, update; requests and proposals (--space).

Aliases: `kbs`, `knowledge-base`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman kb create`](#spaceman-kb-create) | Add a knowledge base |
| [`spaceman kb get`](#spaceman-kb-get) | A knowledge base with its sessions, requests and proposals |
| [`spaceman kb list`](#spaceman-kb-list) | A space's knowledge bases with capacity and usage |
| [`spaceman kb proposal`](#spaceman-kb-proposal) | Knowledge base proposals (listed by `kb get`): accept or reject |
| [`spaceman kb request`](#spaceman-kb-request) | Knowledge base requests (listed by `kb get`) |
| [`spaceman kb update`](#spaceman-kb-update) | Edit a knowledge base (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman kb create

Add a knowledge base.

```sh
spaceman kb create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-kb` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman kb create --space payments runbooks --name Runbooks --repo repos/runbooks --role kb --write-policy review
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allowed-role` | string, repeatable |  | role that may ask the knowledge base (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--base-branch` | string |  | branch answers and proposals start from |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `--entry-instructions` | string |  | instructions given to each session |
| `--entry-instructions-file` | string |  | read --entry-instructions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idle-sleep-seconds` | integer |  | idle time before a session sleeps |
| `--max-sessions` | integer |  | concurrent sessions, 1-16 |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |
| `--repo` | string |  | repository folder in the space, e.g. repos/kb (required; added to the space's repositories when new) |
| `--request-timeout-seconds` | integer |  | how long a request may take |
| `--role` | string |  | space role that answers requests (required) |
| `--session-ttl-seconds` | integer |  | how long a session lives |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--validator` | string, repeatable |  | validator command argument (replaces the list) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--write-policy` | string |  | read_only, review (proposals need acceptance) or serialized |

## spaceman kb update

Edit a knowledge base (only the flags given change).


API: `get-kb`, `update-kb` ([HTTP API](../api)).

|---|---|---|---|

| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idle-sleep-seconds` | integer |  | idle time before a session sleeps |
